Rewrote 'There's a better way.' to 'A better approach exists — one that comes from a 1971 psychometrics textbook.'
Rewrote 'Gf is what you need when...' to 'Gf — the capacity you draw on when you encounter a problem for the first time.'
Rewrote 'The question wasn't... the architecture was set. The question was...' to 'The architecture had already settled *what* to build. The open question: *how to sequence the implementation*.'
Replaced 'The analogy isn't perfect.' with 'The analogy stretches at certain points.'
Replaced 'The result is an architecture with...' with 'The result: an architecture with...' (colon substitution).
